spliceTooExpensive: NO ENOUGH MONEY FOR DA SPLICE!
headerText: SPEND YA {budget} TRAIT POINTS. DRAWBACKS PAY POINTS BACK!
incompatibleNote: CLASHES WIT A TRAIT YOU HAB ALREADY TAKEN!
unaffordableNote: NO ENOUGH TRAIT POINTS LEFT FOR DIS ONE!

soldier.name: OLD SOLDIER
soldier.description: YEARS UNDER ARMS, A FLAT VOICE AN' A HABIT DAT CAME HOME WIT DEM!

scholar.name: SCHOLAR
scholar.description: A BRILLIANT, WELL-READ MIND DAT HAB SPENT TOO LONG TOO CLOSE TA DA PAGE!

outlaw.name: OUTLAW
outlaw.description: LIGHT FINGERS, LIGHTER SCRUPLES, AN' A NAME SOMEBODY IZ STILL LOOKIN' FOR!

healer.name: HEALER
healer.description: HERBS, PATIENCE AN' A REFUSAL TA RAISE A HAND TA ANYONE!

mystic.name: MYSTIC
mystic.description: BORN TA DA WORK, VERSED IN DA STILL, AN' CAREFUL ABOUT OMENS!

brawler.name: BRAWLER
brawler.description: BUILT FOR IT, TRAINED FOR IT, AN' QUICK TA FIND A REASON!

noble.name: NOBLE BORN
noble.description: A HOUSE, AN INHERITANCE AN' A MANNER DAT OPENS DOORS!

wanderer.name: WANDERER
wanderer.description: READS DA LAND, FOLLOWS A TRACK AN' NEVER LOSES DA WAY HOME!

gunslinger.name: GUNSLINGER
gunslinger.description: A STEADY EYE, A FAST HAND AN' REAL LIL' HESITATION!

pilgrim.name: PILGRIM
pilgrim.description: A ROAD WALKED FOR A CREED, AN' A CREED CARRIED QUIETLY!

performer.name: PERFORMER
performer.description: A VOICE DAT CARRIES, A TASTE FOR PLEASURE AN' A WAY WIT AN AUDIENCE!

merchant.name: MERCHANT
merchant.description: A NOSE FOR A PRICE, AN EYE ON DA LADDER AN' A TONGUE DAT CLOSES DEALS!

hexed.name: HEXED
hexed.description: MARKED, SCARRED AN' OUT OF FAVOUR WIT WHOEVER IZ MEANT TA BE LISTENIN'!

tinkerer.name: TINKERER
tinkerer.description: FORGE, WORKBENCH AN' A WORKIN' DAY NOBODY ELSE WOULD KEEP!

beastkin.name: BEASTKIN
beastkin.description: RAISED BY SOMETHIN' WIT FOUR LEGS, AN' IT STILL SHOWS IN DA WALK!

hermit.name: HERMIT
hermit.description: OWNS THREE THINGS, SPEAKS TA NOBODY, AN' WANTS IT KEPT DAT WAY!

nightborn.name: NIGHTBORN
nightborn.description: SOMETHIN' OLD IN DA BLOOD, A TASTE FOR PAIN, AN' SCARS DAT CAME WIT BOTH!

oracle.name: ORACLE
oracle.description: SEES WHAT HAB NO HAPPENED, HEARS COLOUR, AN' IZ BELIEVED TOO LATE!

firebug.name: FIREBUG
firebug.description: LIGHTS IT, WATCHES IT, AN' IZ KNOWN IN THREE TOWNS FOR EXACTLY DAT!

savant.name: SAVANT
savant.description: NO CAN SIT STILL, FORGETS NOTHIN' READ, AN' ANSWERS IN FOUR LANGUAGES!

giant.name: GIANT
giant.description: TOO BIG FOR DA DOOR, STRONG ENOUGH NO TA MIND, AN' HEARD FROM DA NEXT STREET!

smallfolk.name: SMALLFOLK
smallfolk.description: LIL', FOLDED IN WAYS A BODY SHOULD NO FOLD, AN' HANDY WIT EITHER HAND!

shadow.name: SHADOW
shadow.description: TRAINED TA END THINGS QUIETLY, REMEMBERED BY NOBODY, MOVED BY NOTHIN'!

monk.name: MONK
monk.description: YEARS IN A COLD CLOISTER, ONE BOWL, AN' NO GRUDGE WORTH KEEPIN'!

silent.name: SILENT ONE
silent.description: HAB NO SPOKEN IN YEARS, SEES FACES WRONG, AN' WEARS DA REASON!

doomsayer.name: DOOMSAYER
doomsayer.description: BELIEVES IN NOTHIN', EXPECTS DA WORST, AN' IZ TERRIFIED OF DA END ANYWAY!

caveborn.name: CAVEBORN
caveborn.description: BORN UNDER DA ROCK, WHITE AS DA STONE, AN' AFRAID OF DA DARK ALL DA SAME!

gambler.name: GAMBLER
gambler.description: NO CAN WALK PAST A TABLE, WINS MORE DEN DEY SHOULD, AN' LIES ABOUT BOTH!

predator.name: LONE PREDATOR
predator.description: IT HUNTS ALONE, MARKS A RANGE AN' DOES NO SHARE IT!

packbeast.name: PACK BEAST
packbeast.description: IT READS A PACK DA WAY PEOPLE READ A ROOM, AN' IT HAB ALREADY CHOSEN A LEADER!

scavenger.name: SCAVENGER
scavenger.description: IT EATS WHAT IZ LEFT, DIGS WHERE IT MUST AN' RUNS FROM ALMOST EVERYTHIN'!

armoured.name: ARMOURED THING
armoured.description: HIDE TOO THICK TA CUT, A BITE WORTH AVOIDIN' AN' A LONG WINTER SLEEP!
